rationale: This revised plan addresses all three feedback items from the prior evaluation. First, it expands collect_findings sources from [T2, T6] to [T2, T5, T6, T7] to include all major analytical outputs—denial analysis (T2), fraud exploration (T5), and both predictive models (T6, T7)—improving completeness and providing comprehensive context for executive decision-making. Second, it enables cite_artifacts in brief_sections to ensure every numeric statement carries a [source: ...] citation, directly addressing the reproducibility gap where 0 of 5 numeric statements were previously cited. The brief structure remains focused on key findings, model results, limitations, and next steps, with causal language avoided to prevent misinterpretation of descriptive and comparative results. The write_report component maintains all four critical caveats (synthetic_data, descriptive_only, association_not_causation, no_operational_use) through applied skills, protecting readers from misinterpreting findings or deploying analytical results operationally without proper validation.
changes_summary: Expanded collect_findings sources from [T2, T6] to [T2, T5, T6, T7] to include fraud exploration and second model; enabled cite_artifacts in brief_sections to ensure all numeric statements are cited to their source artifacts, addressing reproducibility gap.
